product.title: Scenic Full Day Circle Island Tour-Snorkeling/Breakfast/Byodo-in

description.text: There are many Circle Island tours on offer in Oahu but this one delivers a small-group, crowd- and traffic-free experience. With an early-morning pickup from Waikiki hotels, you're on the road before the rest, which means no lines at the island's top attractions, including the Diamond Head Lookout and Halona Blowhole.Benefit from your local Hawaiian guide's insights into local culture Start your day off right with an included breakfast burrito Enjoy hassle-free hotel pickup and drop-off in Waikiki Includes admission to Byodo-In Temple and an unrushed experience Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Oahu's coastlines, valleys, and cultural landmarks. Ideal for travelers basing in Honolulu who want a guided Oahu experience without coordinating transport, gear, or admission tickets on their own.
